ask: 托盘小卡片把说明截成两行（点开「全部」能看全），行吗？

claude.answer: Pass for the win: 所得 — 修为 +24 · 灵石 +7 · 已入账, new card 石兽 (face whole), 收进储物袋：新 符 · 新 赤石脂. No 「还有」 chip in the footer (none shown, nothing cut). Unsure: the soft summary-clamp (also shots 027, 031, 051, 055 — the same 每日 card, 「已做 10:06 酬 修为 +27 · 灵石 +3 · 晨练符」, clamped to two lines by design; the whole line is in the 事 book). In all five the card sits at the tray's right edge, scrolled mostly off screen, so its clamped text cannot be seen in the picture; at 1280 (080) the same card shows the line whole. No ruling in rulings.jsonl answers this.
